name: Wooden rail fence
description: A rustic fence section of weathered grey-brown wood: two round split posts near the ends and two slightly sagging split rails running the full tile, so sections join end to end.

provenance.prompt: A rustic village rail fence section, 1 tile long (1.5 m) along x through the tile centre, about 1.1 m high: two round split posts near the ends and two slightly sagging, split horizontal rails between them, rails running the full tile width so sections join end to end. Weathered grey-brown wood. Footprint 1x1 tile. Fence category; no interaction, destructible (wood, closed mesh), dynamic bake; blocks movement, does not block sight, cover none.
